proof_body:
by
  intro X _ f K a x₀ n hK0 hK1 hL ha
  have h1 : ∀ m : ℕ, dist (f^[m] x₀) a ≤ K ^ m * dist x₀ a := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      calc dist (f (f^[m] x₀)) a = dist (f (f^[m] x₀)) (f a) := by rw [ha]
        _ ≤ K * dist (f^[m] x₀) a := hL _ _
        _ ≤ K * (K ^ m * dist x₀ a) := by gcongr
        _ = K ^ (m + 1) * dist x₀ a := by ring
  have h3 : dist x₀ a ≤ dist x₀ (f x₀) + dist (f x₀) a := dist_triangle _ _ _
  have h4 : dist (f x₀) a ≤ K * dist x₀ a := by
    calc dist (f x₀) a = dist (f x₀) (f a) := by rw [ha]
      _ ≤ K * dist x₀ a := hL _ _
  have h1K : 0 < 1 - K := by linarith
  have h5 : dist x₀ a ≤ dist x₀ (f x₀) / (1 - K) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ h1K]
    linarith
  calc dist (f^[n] x₀) a ≤ K ^ n * dist x₀ a := h1 n
    _ ≤ K ^ n * (dist x₀ (f x₀) / (1 - K)) := by gcongr
    _ = K ^ n / (1 - K) * dist x₀ (f x₀) := by ring
target_source: ∀ (X : Type*) [MetricSpace X] (f : X → X) (K : ℝ) (a x₀ : X) (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ K → K < 1 → (∀ x y, dist (f x) (f y) ≤ K * dist x y) → f a = a → dist (f^[n] x₀) a ≤ K ^ n / (1 - K) * dist x₀ (f x₀)
